notes: The wiring diagram image (diagram-v4.png) was not provided; the circuit is inferred from the cover photo and the text: motor driver powered from 3.3V, PWM on D4.
Exact breadboard hole positions are assumed (Nano pins in column strips 4-6, breakout in 10-13); the photo does not show them precisely.
Grove motor driver port names (SIG, NC, VCC, GND, MOT+, MOT-) and the Grove breakout adapter are inferred from the photo (green breakout, Grove cable to blue driver module, red/black motor wires).
Nano Matter port list is limited to the pins used (D4, 3V3, GND, USB-C).
Google Nest Hub Max (Thread border router), Google Home app and software are not part of the physical circuit and are omitted.
The USB-C cable only has a joined edge to the Nano; its other end goes to a computer/power, not modelled.
NC pins of the Grove connectors are joined but not marked electrical because they carry no signal.
